comparison.derivation: Full-white static load: quiescent bound plus three regulated channel currents.

ich.detail: Curve data labels 3.18 mA @ 0.1 V, 6.17 @ 0.2, 8.89 @ 0.3, 11.27 @ 0.4, 13.50 @ 0.5, then '16.12' at every point 0.6..6.0 V (zoomed render checked); p9 modify record V1.1 'Driver IC upgrade, Current change to 16mA'.
ich.scope: WS2812B-V7; per output; typical plateau of the 'VF constant current curve', reached at >= 0.6 V on the output

iq.detail: 'Quiescent Current Io -- -- 1 uA No signal transmission, RGB channel is turned off' (Electrical Characteristics, TA=25 C, VDD=5V, VSS=0V)

limits: Binding check of the L1 full-white supply load at the source test supply: it must reproduce iq + 3*ich. It does not validate the data protocol, gray levels, DOUT, the active IC current or the authored dropout knee below 3.5 V.
